title: Grammar QG P16 Delta — 110 Additional Manual Template Families
authorshipModel: expert-authored structured cases; deterministic assembly from manually curated KS2 grammar examples; no learner-facing AI generation

target.purpose: raise P15 90-family manual pack to 200 new families total

qualityRulesBeforeScheduling: All cases remain draft-only until imported into a reviewable bench bank and signed off.
No new family may enter learner scheduling until it has answerability, grammar logic, distractor, marking, read-aloud and semantic cue evidence.
Selected-response cases must have exactly one defensible correct answer unless explicitly marked multi-select.
Constructed-response families require goldens, accepted variants, near misses, raw prompt probes and smart-punctuation probes.
The scheduler must enforce no same-template repeat in ordinary five-question sessions and no recent-surface repeat inside the configured exposure window.
Star pacing should be measured only after the expanded pool is active; do not slow Stars to compensate for a shallow pool.
